module.name: scbinder
module.description: Phase associator ported from Earthworm's binder_ew (grid-stacking nucleation, L1 relocation). Consumes picks, produces origins.

group.name: binder
group.description: Parameters of the binder_ew algorithm core. The algorithm itself (association grid, velocity model, stacking, location and assessment commands) is configured through a binder_ew.d style command file referenced by "config". An existing Earthworm binder_ew.d works unchanged: transport related commands are recognized and ignored, station lists are taken from the inventory.

parameter.name: config
parameter.description: binder_ew-style command file with the algorithm configuration: grid (grdlat, grdlon, grdz, dspace), stacking (rstack, tstack, stack, thresh, focus, grid_wt), velocity model (lay, psratio), association (taper, t_dif, rAvg_Factor), location (wt, ph, r_max, zrange, locate_eq) and assessment (assess_pk, maxtrial, residual_cut) commands. Nested files can be included with @filename. An example is installed at @DATADIR@/scbinder/binder_example.d.

parameter.name: eventIdFile
parameter.description: File storing the next internal quake id between runs (Earthworm's quake_id.d). Created automatically with "next_id 1" if missing. An EventIdFile command in the binder command file takes precedence.

parameter.name: defaultPickWeight
parameter.description: Earthworm pick quality (0 = best, 4 = unusable) assigned to picks that carry no time uncertainty. Weights control both grid stacking (grid_wt) and location weighting (wt).

parameter.name: weightThresholds
parameter.description: Four ascending pick time uncertainty upper bounds mapping to Earthworm pick quality 0, 1, 2 and 3. Picks with larger uncertainty get quality 4.

option.description: Override binder.config: the binder_ew-style command file.
Do not send any object to messaging.
Event parameters XML file for offline playback: feed all contained picks in time order, log the resulting origins, then exit. Implies --test; messaging is disabled.
